headline: Crypto is waiting on two US events landing overnight Bangkok time: the Fed's October meeting minutes and the pricing of Anthropic's record share sale, with bitcoin near $64,500 and fear still extreme.

market.asOf: Read at about 03:53 UTC Wed 18 Nov (about 10:53 Bangkok). TradingView: BTC $64,785.96 (up 0.26% in 24 hours), ETH $1,819.53 (up 0.21%), SOL $74.89 (up 4.70%). CoinGecko at the same time showed BTC $64,467.68, ETH $1,805.47 and SOL $74.92. Prices move fast; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme fear: alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index 12 (10 yesterday, 32 a week ago, 53 a month ago), read at about 03:52 UTC Wed 18 Nov.

stories.title: Bitcoin waits near $64,500 for the Fed's minutes as a December rate rise looks almost certain
stories.summary: Bitcoin edged up in Asian trading but is still stuck in the mid-$60,000s. Traders now see a December Fed rate rise as close to certain, and higher US bond yields keep pulling money away from riskier assets like crypto. Minutes from the Fed's October meeting come out later today.
points: Bitcoin was at $64,862.82, up 0.9%, and ether at $1,823.74, up 1.0%, in early Asian trading Wednesday, per Reuters via Business Recorder.
The US 10-year Treasury yield was 5.123% and the dollar index 103.66, near its highest since April 2025, per Business Recorder.
CME FedWatch put the chance of a 0.25-point December rate rise at 95.7%, per TechFlow citing Jin10 on 16 Nov. These are market bets, not a Fed decision.
US spot bitcoin ETFs took in a net $7.9 million on Monday 16 Nov, ending seven straight days of outflows, per CoinDesk. Tuesday's figure was not yet out when this was written.
Minutes of the Fed's 27-28 October meeting are due at 2:00pm ET Wednesday (02:00 Thursday Bangkok), per the Federal Reserve.

stories.title: Anthropic's giant share sale is set to price tonight US time
stories.summary: AI company Anthropic is expected to set the price of its first public share sale on Wednesday evening US time, with trading on Nasdaq as ANT from Thursday. Yahoo Finance, citing Bloomberg, says it could be the biggest first-time share sale ever; CoinMarketCap Academy calls it the second-largest IPO on record. Some analysts link part of the recent crypto selling to investors raising cash for it.
points: Bloomberg reported Anthropic is guiding to a price near the top of its $70-78 range, or even above; at $78 it would be valued near $1.4 trillion and raise over $90 billion, per CoinDesk.
The offer is 825 million shares; the raise of up to $90.4 billion includes a $26 billion private placement from seven large tech companies, per Yahoo Finance.
The order book was about 7 times covered as of 15 Nov, per CoinMarketCap Academy.
Pricing is expected Wednesday evening US time and trading on Nasdaq as ANT from Thursday 19 Nov, per CoinMarketCap Academy.
Some crypto venues already list pre-IPO 'ANT' contracts; these give no share ownership and many are not open to US users, per CoinMarketCap Academy.

stories.title: Nvidia beats forecasts, but an SEC probe report and leadership turmoil cloud the picture
stories.summary: Nvidia, whose results have been moving tech stocks and crypto together, reported sales well above forecasts and guided higher. Asian stocks bounced on the news, but bitcoin moved less than 1%, and a report of an SEC investigation added a new worry.
points: Revenue was $115.8 billion, up 103% from a year ago, and data center revenue was $107.6 billion, per Nvidia.
Adjusted earnings were $2.68 a share against $2.47 expected, per CoinDesk.
Nvidia expects next quarter's revenue to be $130.0 billion, plus or minus 3%, assuming no data center compute revenue from China, per Nvidia.
The Wall Street Journal reported the SEC opened a civil probe into whether Nvidia's disclosures misled investors, per TechCrunch.
New chairman Harvey Jones said the board will not reinstate Jensen Huang, who resigned last week, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: CFTC clears Backpack to offer perpetual futures to Americans
briefs.summary: The CFTC approved Backpack as a licensed exchange and clearinghouse, letting it offer US users 24/7 leveraged crypto perpetual futures; tZERO got its exchange approval a week earlier, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Binance hacker moves another $137M of ether
briefs.summary: The hacker moved 74,880 ETH (about $137M) through THORChain on 17 Nov; Binance has frozen about $2.85B in stablecoins from the $6.3B theft, per BigGo.

briefs.title: Lighter exchange accounts hacked after signing software reused nonces
briefs.summary: Attackers computed private keys from public signatures because custom signing software outside Lighter's official SDKs reused cryptographic nonces, taking an estimated $15.5M in USDC from two market-maker accounts (not confirmed by Lighter); about $5M was returned, per Tech Times.

briefs.title: Strategy buys 485 more bitcoin
briefs.summary: Strategy bought 485 BTC for $33.4M between 9 and 15 Nov, bringing its holdings to 850,849 BTC at an average cost of $75,452, per its SEC filing.

briefs.title: Address-swap attack and a Trezor partner data breach
briefs.summary: The Optimizely attack hit 178 organizations but its wallets collected only about $7,150; separately, a breach at Trezor partner Skladon exposed data on about 27,000 hardware-wallet orders, per Decrypt. Double-check any address before you send.

briefs.title: BitMine adds more ether
briefs.summary: BitMine added 7,653 ETH (about $14M), bringing its holdings to 6,077,745 ETH, or 4.97% of supply, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Binance to accept tokenized stocks as margin
briefs.summary: Binance is adding seven tokenized-stock 'bStocks' as margin collateral from 21:00 on 18 Nov (time zone not stated), per ChainCatcher.

calendar.event: CoinShares and Bullish Q3 results; US housing starts
calendar.note: CoinShares reports before the US open, per its announcement; Bullish call at 8:30am ET, per Quiver Quant. Housing starts at 8:30am ET: forecast 1.27M (Finviz) or 1.24M (consensus in TD Economics' table), prior 1.221M.

calendar.event: Fed minutes from the October meeting
calendar.note: Minutes of the 27-28 October meeting. Fed's Barr speaks at 1:35pm ET and Williams at 2:30pm ET, per the Federal Reserve and Finviz.

calendar.event: Anthropic share sale priced, then first trading
calendar.note: Pricing expected Wednesday evening US time and Nasdaq trading as ANT from Thursday; range $70-78, per StockTitan and CoinMarketCap Academy.

calendar.event: US jobless claims and Philly Fed survey
calendar.note: Claims forecast 196,000 (Finviz) or 197,000 (consensus in TD Economics' table), prior 200,000; Philly Fed forecast 19.2, prior 20.9, per Finviz.
Kristin Johnson and Steven Levine before the Senate Banking Committee, per the committee's page.

calendar.event: Weekly bitcoin options expiry on Deribit
calendar.note: About $1.8B of bitcoin options expire at 08:00 UTC, per CryptoTicker. The bigger monthly expiry, about $5.7B, is Fri 27 Nov.

calendar.event: University of Michigan consumer sentiment (Nov, final)
calendar.note: Forecast 52 per Finviz; preliminary reading 51.0. Fed's Cook speaks at 12:15pm ET (00:15 Sat Bangkok), per the Federal Reserve.

calendar.event: Token unlocks: KAITO, ZRO, ARIA, AKE, MBG, SOON, MON, SOSO
calendar.note: Unlock dates are UTC. KAITO and ZRO on Friday 20, ARIA and AKE on Saturday 21, MBG on Sunday 22, SOON on Monday 23, MON (the largest, about $252M) and SOSO on Tuesday 24 November. KAITO's 00:00 UTC unlock is 7:00pm ET Thursday. See the unlock table on this page for sizes, dates and confidence. (Dates from this desk's unlock data.)

calendar.event: US GDP (Q3 second estimate), PCE inflation (Oct), jobless claims
calendar.note: GDP forecast 3.4%, per Finviz. PCE prior 3.6% a year (core 3.1%); no consensus yet. Claims move to Wednesday for Thanksgiving. Fed Beige Book at 2:00pm ET.

calendar.event: Thanksgiving: US stock and bond markets closed, then early close
calendar.note: NYSE closed Thursday and closes at 1:00pm ET Friday, per NYSE.

calendar.event: Next Fed meeting and rate decision
calendar.note: Meeting 8-9 December with new projections, per the Federal Reserve. CME FedWatch put the odds at about 96% for a 0.25-point rise and about 4% for a 0.5-point rise, per TechFlow.
